metadata.name: payment_rails
metadata.description: USDC money layer for NUNDINA: escrow, bonds, refunds, DvP cash leg, payouts to attested wallets only (SRS 08 §4.2/§4.4/§4.5). Audit-scope-critical.

types.name: CashSession
docs: The cash side of one auction session (AE-P1/P3/P10).
Everything a refund depends on is snapshotted here at open, so a later
config change can never strand or re-route escrowed cash (L5).

fields.name: operator
docs: Operator that opened the session (config snapshot) — reports reveals
and failure. Cannot move cash.

fields.name: session_id
docs: Operator-chosen id; part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Settlement mint snapshot.

fields.name: reserve
docs: Reserve token account snapshot (forfeited bonds, reserve cut).

fields.name: fee_receiver
docs: Fee token account snapshot.

fields.name: asset_mint
docs: Traded asset (NPCS or a queue-claim token). Sellers escrow it; each
fill delivers it to the buyer atomically with the cash leg (DvP).

fields.name: asset_decimals
docs: Asset decimals: prices are micro-USDC per whole asset unit.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Fee bps snapshot.

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Reserve bps snapshot.

fields.name: rofr_authority
docs: Issuer ROFR authority (AE-P7); `Pubkey::default()` = no ROFR.

fields.name: commit_end
docs: Deposits accepted while `now < commit_end`.

fields.name: reveal_end
docs: Reveals reported while `commit_end <= now < reveal_end`; unrevealed
escrows become forfeitable at `reveal_end`.

fields.name: settle_deadline
docs: Hard deadline (AE-P10): at/after it every escrow is refundable by
anyone, whatever the session state.

fields.name: bond_amount
docs: Bond every escrow posts (micro-USDC, forfeitable).

fields.name: max_cash
docs: Per-investor cash cap (AE-P3 bid caps; one escrow per owner).

fields.name: status
docs: Running / aborted.

fields.name: failed_at
docs: When the operator failed the session (0 while open).

fields.name: open_escrows

fields.name: total_bonds

fields.name: total_asset

fields.name: fills_settled

dedicated vault owned by this PDA — never in a shared pool (AE-P10).

fields.name: asset

fields.name: asset_vault

fields.name: bond
docs: Bond held (micro-USDC); 0 once forfeited.

fields.name: revealed

moved seller → buyer in the same instruction.

fields.name: fill_index

fields.name: buyer

fields.name: seller
docs: Seller wallet.

fields.name: to_seller

types.name: FillSplit
docs: Cash split of one fill. `to_seller + fee + to_reserve == gross` always.

fields.name: fee

fields.name: to_reserve
docs: Reserve cut: `floor(gross × reserve_bps / 10⁴)`.

fields.name: to_seller
docs: Seller proceeds: the remainder.

types.name: PayoutDestination

fields.name: token_account
docs: The one USDC token account payouts may go to (owned by `owner`).

fields.name: attestation_ref_hash
docs: Hash of the off-chain attestation / KYC reference. Never raw data.

fields.name: registrar
docs: Registrar that admitted / last renewed it.

fields.name: expires_at

fields.name: active
docs: `false` once revoked (block-list precedence, CG-P5).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: source

fields.name: destination

fields.name: amount

types.name: RailsConfig
docs: The one global rails configuration.
Every cash path reads it: the settlement mint all escrows are
denominated in, where fees and forfeited bonds go, and the two halt
switches. Consumers (auction sessions, facility advances) snapshot the
fields they depend on at open — the rails never re-route an in-flight
session's cash (L5 snapshot discipline). Updates are governed (Squads
2-of-2) and always evented.

fields.name: authority
docs: Squads 2-of-2: sole authority for this PDA (SRS §8 protocol authority).

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Settlement mint (USDC). Every escrow, bond and payout uses it.

fields.name: fee_receiver
docs: USDC token account receiving protocol fees (AE-P8 fee split).

fields.name: reserve
docs: USDC token account receiving forfeited bonds and the reserve cut
(AE-P4, LF-P5 shortfall buffer).

fields.name: operator
docs: Sole key allowed to open cash sessions and report their outcomes
(reveals, failure). Set to the authority at init; re-pointed to the
auction-engine's session-signer PDA once that program exists (Q1).

fields.name: registrar
docs: Payout-registry key (R3): the only key that can admit, renew or
revoke payout destinations. Stands in for the SAS attester until the
gate's attestation read is on-chain (Q2). Set to the authority at init.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Protocol fee on each fill's gross, bps (≤ `MAX_FEE_BPS`).

fields.name: reserve_bps
docs: Reserve cut on each fill's gross, bps (≤ `MAX_RESERVE_BPS`).

fields.name: paused
docs: Operational pause (authority-set). Blocks new money in; refunds stay
open (AE-P10: refunds are never pausable).

fields.name: depeg_breaker
docs: Settlement-asset depeg breaker (06 §2, F4/M5). Tripped ⇒ no new
settlement at a price denominated in a broken USDC; refunds stay open.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: session

docs: Hard refund deadline (AE-P10).

types.name: SessionParams
docs: Operator-chosen session parameters, snapshotted at open (AE-P1, L5).

fields.name: commit_end
docs: Deposits accepted while `now < commit_end`.

fields.name: reveal_end
docs: Reveals reported until `reveal_end`; settlement opens at it.

fields.name: settle_deadline
docs: Hard deadline: settlement closes, every escrow refundable.

fields.name: bond_amount

types.name: SessionStatus
docs: Lifecycle of a cash session. Deliberately tiny: the auction phases live
in auction-engine; the rails only need to know "still running" vs
"aborted, release everything".

types.name: Side
docs: Which side of the book an escrow is on.

types.name: TransferInstruction
docs: The AE-P8 transfer record, emitted once per settled fill right after
`FillSettled` (#61). `FillSettled` carries the economics. This event
carries what a transfer agent (doc 07 L21) and a books-and-records export
(L22) need to show the transfer was lawful.
Until the gate's lot ledger and settle-time re-check exist, every fill
emits `lot_ids = []`, `exemption_path = NotRecorded` and
`gate_check = NotPerformed`. The absence of a compliance check is then
visible in the event stream, not only in a doc (#53).

fields.name: session
docs: Session.

fields.name: fill_index
docs: Fill index within the session (joins to `FillSettled`).

fields.name: from
docs: Seller wallet (asset leaves).

fields.name: to
docs: Buyer wallet (asset arrives; issuer on the ROFR path).

fields.name: qty
docs: Asset base units transferred.

fields.name: price
docs: Price, micro-USDC per whole asset unit.

fields.name: lot_ids
docs: Lots the transferred units came from, at most `MAX_LOTS_PER_FILL`.

fields.name: exemption_path
docs: Exemption basis relied on for this resale.

fields.name: gate_check
docs: Whether the gate's final re-check ran in this transaction.

fields.name: disclosure_hash
docs: Disclosure-policy hash (same value as `FillSettled`).
